finalText:
Build's clean now (exit 0). The remaining 8 warnings are the deprecation-noise lines (`DEP0142`, `DEP0198`, etc.) that are just informational, not the actual break.

What was wrong: the bundler bump changed the options shape it hands to modules from `{ retries }` to `{ retryCount }`, and its config loader now leaves unset flags as `undefined` instead of `false`. Two call sites hadn't been updated for either change:

- `src/core/options.js:7` — `resolveRetries` read `options.retries` (now always `undefined`), crashing on `.toFixed()`. Fixed to read `options.retryCount`.
- `src/net/retryPolicy.js:7-11` — `isBackoffEnabled` only accepted explicit `true`/`false` and threw on `undefined`. Simplified to `flags.backoffEnabled === true`, treating any non-`true` value (including unset) as disabled.
